Anant Singh Daughter Wedding : bihar ke bahubli neta anant sinh ke ghar aaj beti shivangi ki shadi ki shahnaee bajne vali hai. shivangi ki shadi ko lekar ghar men jashn aur taiyariyon ka mahaul hai. is khas shadi samaroh men shamil hone ke lie mehmanon ka pahunchna jari hai. vahin, panjab ke ludhiyana se 25 se adhik kinnar patna pahunche hain, jo var-vadhu ko aashirvad denge. anant sinh ki beti ki shadi ko lekar khas utsah dekhne ko mil raha hai. dekhie shadi samaroh ki taiyariyan aur mehmanon ki khas maujudgi.
